program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # diff pair L
    "Itail": (1.0e-6, 0.8e-6, 2e-6), # tail current
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS load / M7 gm/Id (equal -> low systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),        # PMOS load / M7 L
    "I7":    (6.5e-6, 4e-6, 8e-6),   # second-stage current
    "Lm":    (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "fgbw":  (1.3e6, 1.05e6, 2e6),   # target GBW -> sets Cc
    "kz":    (2.0, 0.8, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmid_m = 10.0
    Lm = p["Lm"]; Lp = p["Lp"]
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2

    m9 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, iref, vds=0.7)              # reference diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["Itail"], vds=0.4)        # tail
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["I7"], vds=0.9)           # output sink
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.4)       # diff pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I1, vds=0.9)            # mirror load
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, p["I7"], vds=0.9)       # 2nd stage CS

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    rz = p["kz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")

    def put(name, d, g, s, b, op, typ):
        if op.W < 0.42:
            n.M(name, d, g, s, b, typ, 0.42, op.L)
        else:
            n.dev(name, d, g, s, b, op)

    put("M9", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m9, "nfet")
    put("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5, "nfet")
    put("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8, "nfet")
    put("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1, "nfet")
    put("M2", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1, "nfet")
    put("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3, "pfet")
    put("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3, "pfet")
    put("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7, "pfet")
    n.R("Rz", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", cc)

    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgg
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (c1 * cc + cl * cc + c1 * cl) / (2 * PI)
    den = cc * (rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * den) if den > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1) if c1 > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3))
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + p["I7"])
    slew = min(p["Itail"] / cc, p["I7"] / (cl + cc))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
